_about: The stadium builder: four stands, four corners, roofs, boxes and club-wide upgrades. Read by src/sim/career/stadium.ts. Money in Valmeran dollars; weeks are calendar weeks (pre-season and season). Every club owns a stadium; AI clubs build over the off-season when they sell out and can afford it.

stands._about: Seats by stand level for a side stand (west, east). Ends (north, south) hold endScale of that. Level 0 is an open grass bank with standing room. Raising a level costs the seats it adds x costPerSeat for the new level, plus a flat fee, and takes weeks.
stands._aboutClosure: Work on a stand during the season closes this share of its seats until it is done. Off-season and pre-season work closes nothing (there are no home matches).

corners._about: Corner infills join two stands. Level 1 needs both neighbours at stand level 2 or more; level 2 needs both at 3 or more.

roof._about: Per stand: 0 none, 1 cover over the back rows, 2 full cantilever roof. Cost scales with the stand's seats. Covered seats raise attendance (attendanceBonus x covered share of all seats) and keep the noise in.

boxes._about: Executive boxes in rows along a stand's back. A row needs the stand at level 2 or more (a second row at 3). Hospitality per home match = boxes x pricePerMatch x (0.5 + market) x occupancy; occupancy = base + perMarket x market + perMood x fan mood, clamped.

upgrades._about: Club-wide upgrades. cost[i] buys level i + 1 and weeks[i] is how long it takes. Effects by level are in each entry. The catalogue and its payback times are set out in docs/DESIGN.md section 10.

floodlights.name: Floodlights
floodlights.about: Brighter lights for evening TV slots. Adds TV money every season.

videoBoard.name: Video board
videoBoard.about: Replays and adverts. Lifts the shirt sponsor's value and keeps the fans happier.

signage.name: LED advertising
signage.about: Pitch-side and ring screens sell more advertising. Lifts sponsor money.

concourse.name: Concourses
concourse.about: Wider walkways, more kiosks and bars. More money from food and drink per fan, and a better day out.

shop.name: Club shop
shop.about: From a kiosk to a megastore. More merchandise money every season.

pitch.name: Pitch
pitch.about: Drainage, then a hybrid surface, then undersoil heating. A better pitch lifts the stadium's condition and draws bigger crowds.

condition._about: Stadium condition (0-1) feeds attendance. It wears down each season; a refurbishment costs perSeat x capacity and restores restore points, capped at max. Refurbishing is offered once condition is more than refurbishMargin below max.

demand._about: How many people want to come, in seats. Starts at the club's original capacity, grows when fans are happy and the team wins, shrinks when they are not. Attendance share = engine share x demand / capacity (plus roof and board bonuses), clamped, so a bigger ground only fills if the demand is there.

projects._about: At most maxActive projects at once. A project paid for during the season can start now (closing seats) or wait for the off-season. The off-season (the winter break) adds summerWeeks of building before pre-season.

ai._about: Each off-season an AI club picks one project. If its condition is below refurbishBelow it refurbishes, when its cash covers the cost refurbishCashMultiple times over. Else, if its crowds averaged at least fullShare of capacity, it builds the stand or corner with the lowest cost per seat that its cash covers cashMultiple times over. Else it adds the cheapest roof its cash covers roofCashMultiple times over.

start._about: The ground each club starts a career with (read by initialStadium). Stands go up one level at a time, lowest first, while the total stays within overshoot seats of the club's listed capacity. Then roofs, boxes and upgrades follow the club's finances (0-1): the Main Stand gets a full roof above mainFullRoof (or at three tiers or bigger), a back-rows roof otherwise; other single-tier-or-bigger stands get a full roof above bigFullRoof; small stands get a back-rows roof above smallRoof. The Main Stand gets a second row of boxes above mainSecondBoxes, the East Stand one row above eastBoxes. Each upgrade starts at level 1 above its threshold: floodlights, videoBoard and concourse on finances, shop on market size, pitch on stadium condition.

look._about: Free, instant branding choices. Seat schemes colour the seats; mow patterns cut the grass.

view._about: The 3D stadium on the Stadium tab (read by src/render/stadium/view.ts). Azimuth and elevation are degrees: azimuth 0 puts the camera on the Main Stand side, 90 behind the South End, 180 on the East Stand side, 270 behind the North End. Zoom 1 fits the whole ground; smaller is closer. A focus 'shift' moves the point the camera turns around from the centre spot towards the picked part (0 stays on the centre spot, 1 is the middle of the part). A focus with 'inside' true keeps the camera over the pitch (no further back than the opposite stand's front), so a big stand on the near side never hides the one you picked. The crowd drawn is the share of seats filled at the club's last home match this season, or crowdFallback before there has been one.

ambient._about: The title screen's slow turn around the ground at dusk (Stage 7.6): degrees a second, the camera's elevation and zoom, the sky's top and horizon colours (Longlight purple to copper), and how brightly the stands' own lights glow.
